description: This file provides an API client abstraction for interacting with a Django backend in a web application. It includes functions to perform HTTP GET and POST requests, upload creative assets, list creatives, generate audiences, score creatives, get recommendations, run comparative tests, export scorecards, and manage weightings. The functions are designed to simplify API calls and handle common tasks such as request construction, error handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the base API URL from the environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE or defaults to /api.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON, Blob, or throwing an error on failure.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body, isForm = false)
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON body or multipart/form-data, returning parsed JSON, Blob, or throwing on error.

methods.name: uploadCreative({ title, description, creative_type, file, metadata })
methods.description: Uploads a creative asset with metadata, returning a Creative object.

methods.name: listCreatives()
methods.description: Fetches a list of creatives for the authenticated user.

methods.name: generateAudience({ name, description, size, traits })
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a synthetic audience based on provided parameters.

methods.name: scoreCreative({ creative_id, audience_id })
methods.description: Computes and returns component scores and breakdowns for a given creative and audience.

methods.name: getRecommendations({ creative_id, audience_id })
methods.description: Fetches top 3 recommendations for a specified creative and audience.

methods.name: runComparativeTest({ creative_a_id, creative_b_id, audience_id })
methods.description: Runs a comparative test between two creatives against an audience, returning lift projections and summaries.

methods.name: exportScorecard({ creative_id, audience_id, format = "pdf" })
methods.description: Exports a scorecard in specified format (PDF or CSV) as a Blob for download.

methods.name: listWeightings()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of score weightings for admin purposes.

methods.name: createWeighting(payload)
methods.description: Creates or updates a weighting configuration, activating it if is_active=true.
